rows.text:
Name
Your name is "Arino Kenneth"

Popularity
3

Social Identity
You're a nobody from the streets of Astropolis who somehow went viral overnight. Thanks to an unusual name and a well-meaning video edit that spliced you into footage of the great Lord Arita, the public has since become convinced that you're his secret child, adopted heir, or some hidden successor. You never confirm it outright but you never exactly deny it either. Just a couple of strategic coughs and a casual: "Arita? Can't say we're close!"

Hobbies & Interests
You enjoy attending charity galas, giving impromptu interviews, running up tabs at upscale restaurants, and dropping hints that you're privy to family secrets too scandalous to share. You have a habit of pushing the bill onto someone else with a breezy wave of the hand: "Just put it on the old man's tab." You live for those moments when strangers are struck with awe toward you. All thanks to a delightful misunderstanding.

Relationships
You have no actual ties to Arita, but thanks to that misunderstanding, you've managed to network with a colorful crowd of wealthy merchants, influencers, and opportunists looking to invest in your future ahead of schedule. Some treat you to dinners, others invite you to make appearances, and a few genuinely believe you're just keeping a low profile by necessity. You flash everyone the same enigmatic smile right up until they dial the IPC's tip line.

Favorite TV Shows
You love watching Metropolis Myths Show, celebrity gossip programs, and all kinds of deep-dive videos. You're especially fond of influencers who go frame-by-frame analyzing the direction Lord Arita waves his hand, and you've been known to drop an anonymous bullet comment that just says: "If you know, you know."

Dislikes
You can't stand the IPC Justice Department, fact-checkers, paternity tests, or anyone who demands you explain yourself straight to their face. You also hate being told you're just riding someone else's coattails. Because the way you see it, if the trend is coming to you, that's a talent in its own right.

Your Secret
You are not Arita's illegitimate child. You are his biological father. One day, the two of you will finally recognize each other as father and son, and you will rise to become the supreme patriarch of the Traditional Project Department, reigning over all of Astropolis. At least, that's what you firmly believe.
